summary: Architecture classification and stable IDs pass deterministic shape validation. The design is feasible within existing Core/Infrastructure/Web ownership, preserves ordinary migrations and authorization, and supplies controlled and PostgreSQL test seams. Cross-database authority cannot be atomic, so protected use rechecks live permission. The accepted October proposal supports fixed database-per-batch storage; AD-2/3/6 and the Constitution support separate policy, persistence and source-tool ownership. No unresolved template placeholder remains; the 18.1 interface is an intentional dependency hold.
classification_reason: Adds a dedicated October persistence boundary and a shared generator-Web exact-selection contract under O-FR17/18 and O-AR03/04.
planned_change_trigger_assessment: Architecture classification requires early independent plan review. Current content does not add/materially change a Worker Agent tool or Scan strategy and does not change or weaken the PRD; reassess after 18.1 reconciliation.
dependency_hold: ID-I04, ID-L03 and ID-T04 remain unresolved until an integrated verified Story 18.1 baseline is reconciled before task generation.
evidence_disposition: Static planning only; no database, provider, host, migration, paid call or Story 18.1 runtime was exercised.
optional_preference_question: The provisional source-neutral provider binding uses one explicitly supplied configuration source per process, no unspecified .env discovery and no protected-row copy.
